description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul is astonished that the Galatians are turning to another gospel, which is no gospel at all. He insists that his gospel came from God by revelation, not from people, and tells how he was called and first visited Jerusalem.
1.sw: Paulo anashangaa kwamba Wagalatia wanageukia injili nyingine, ambayo si injili hata kidogo. Anasisitiza kwamba Injili yake ilitoka kwa Mungu kwa ufunuo, si kwa wanadamu, na kueleza jinsi alivyoitwa na kutembelea Yerusalemu mara ya kwanza.
1.am: ጳውሎስ የገላትያ ሰዎች ወንጌል ወዳልሆነ ወደ ሌላ ወንጌል መመለሳቸው ያስደንቀዋል። ወንጌሉ ከሰዎች ሳይሆን በመገለጥ ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ መጣ አጥብቆ ይናገራል፤ እንዴት እንደ ተጠራና ኢየሩሳሌምን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ጎበኘም ይተርካል።

2.en: The leaders in Jerusalem accepted Paul and his gospel to the Gentiles. When Cephas drew back from eating with Gentiles in Antioch, Paul opposed him, for a person is made righteous by faith in Jesus, not by works of the law.
2.sw: Viongozi wa Yerusalemu walimkubali Paulo na Injili yake kwa watu wa mataifa. Kefa alipojitenga na kula pamoja na watu wa mataifa huko Antiokia, Paulo alimpinga, kwa maana mtu anahesabiwa haki kwa imani katika Yesu, si kwa matendo ya sheria.
2.am: የኢየሩሳሌም መሪዎች ጳውሎስንና ለአሕዛብ የሚሰብከውን ወንጌል ተቀበሉ። ኬፋ በአንጾኪያ ከአሕዛብ ጋር ከመብላት ራሱን ባገለለ ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ተቃወመው፤ ሰው የሚጸድቀው በሕግ ሥራ ሳይሆን በኢየሱስ በማመን ነውና።

3.en: The Galatians received the Spirit by faith, not by works of the law, and those who believe are Abraham's children. Jesus set us free from the curse of the law, the law cannot cancel the promise to Abraham, and now all are one, no longer under a guardian.
3.sw: Wagalatia walipokea Roho kwa imani, si kwa matendo ya sheria, na wale wanaoamini ni watoto wa Abrahamu. Yesu ametuweka huru kutoka katika laana ya sheria, sheria haiwezi kufuta ahadi aliyopewa Abrahamu, na sasa wote ni wamoja, hawako tena chini ya mlezi.
3.am: የገላትያ ሰዎች መንፈስን የተቀበሉት በሕግ ሥራ ሳይሆን በእምነት ነው፤ የሚያምኑም የአብርሃም ልጆች ናቸው። ኢየሱስ ከሕግ እርግማን ነጻ አውጥቶናል፤ ሕጉ ለአብርሃም የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል ሊሽር አይችልም፤ አሁንም ሁሉም አንድ ናቸው፤ ከእንግዲህ በሞግዚት ሥር አይደሉም።

4.en: Believers are no longer slaves but God's children and heirs, so why turn back to slavery? Paul pleads with the Galatians as a parent and uses Hagar and Sarah as a picture of two covenants.
4.sw: Waamini si watumwa tena bali ni watoto wa Mungu na warithi, basi kwa nini warudi utumwani? Paulo anawasihi Wagalatia kama mzazi na kutumia Hajiri na Sara kama picha ya maagano mawili.
4.am: አማኞች ከእንግዲህ ባሪያዎች ሳይሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆችና ወራሾች ናቸው፤ ታዲያ ለምን ወደ ባርነት ይመለሳሉ? ጳውሎስ የገላትያን ሰዎች እንደ ወላጅ ይማጸናቸዋል፤ አጋርንና ሣራንም የሁለት ኪዳኖች ምሳሌ አድርጎ ይጠቀምባቸዋል።

5.en: Believers must stand firm in the freedom Jesus has won and not submit again to slavery. Freedom is for serving one another in love, and those who walk by the Spirit bear the Spirit's fruit.
5.sw: Waamini lazima wasimame imara katika uhuru ambao Yesu ameupata kwa ajili yao na wasikubali tena kuwa watumwa. Uhuru ni kwa ajili ya kutumikiana kwa upendo, na wale wanaoenenda kwa Roho huzaa tunda la Roho.
5.am: አማኞች ኢየሱስ ባስገኘላቸው ነጻነት ጸንተው መቆም አለባቸው፤ ዳግመኛም ለባርነት መገዛት የለባቸውም። ነጻነት እርስ በርስ በፍቅር ለመገልገል ነው፤ በመንፈስ የሚመላለሱም የመንፈስን ፍሬ ያፈራሉ።

6.en: Believers are to carry one another's burdens and do good, for they will reap what they sow. Paul writes his last words in his own hand, boasting only in the cross.
6.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kubebeana mizigo na kutenda mema, kwa maana watavuna kile wanachopanda. Paulo anaandika maneno yake ya mwisho kwa mkono wake mwenyewe, akijivuna katika msalaba peke yake.
6.am: አማኞች አንዱ የሌላውን ሸክም መሸከምና መልካም ማድረግ ይገባቸዋል፤ የዘሩትን ያጭዳሉና። ጳውሎስ የመጨረሻ ቃላቱን በገዛ እጁ ይጽፋል፤ የሚመካውም በመስቀሉ ብቻ ነው።
